stories.headline: Nvidia Sets All-Time Market Cap Record at $5.26 Trillion After 4% Surge

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's market capitalization hit $5.26 trillion on Monday April 27, the highest ever for a publicly traded company, after a 4% share price jump.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia recorded the highest ever market capitalization in the history of publicly traded companies Monday, reaching nearly $5.3 trillion after shares closed

key_facts.fact: Nvidia shares are now up 16% year-to-date after slumping in March.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Nvidia are now up 16% on the year after slumping in March.

key_facts.fact: The rally was driven by the ongoing data center boom and AI infrastructure spending by hyperscalers.
key_facts.excerpt: Stocks Inch to New Records as Nvidia Strength Overcomes Consumer Weakness

key_facts.fact: Nvidia currently trades at roughly 24x forward earnings, a discount to customers like Broadcom (35x) despite having the strongest competitive moat in the semiconductor stack.
key_facts.excerpt: The AI chipmaker has rebounded from its recent correction, but is there additional upside ahead?

stories.headline: Photonics Chipmaker Lightelligence Surges ~400% in Hong Kong IPO Debut, Raising $310M

key_facts.fact: Shanghai-based Lightelligence shares surged as much as 408% to HK$930 after pricing at HK$183.20 in its Hong Kong Stock Exchange main board debut on April 28.
key_facts.excerpt: Lightelligence turned what might have been a routine listing into a full-blown market spectacle on Tuesday, with its shares surging as much as 408% to HK$930 after pricing at HK$183.20

key_facts.fact: The company raised about HK$2.5 billion (~$310M) in its IPO, and its market capitalization briefly topped HK$80.9 billion (~$10.3 billion).
key_facts.excerpt: market capitalization top HK$80.9 billion (about $10.3 billion) at one point... net proceeds of approximately HK$2.53 billion (about $322.5 million)

key_facts.fact: The retail tranche was oversubscribed 5,784.7 times, with cornerstone investors including Alibaba, GIC, Temasek, and BlackRock subscribing to more than 71% of the offering.
key_facts.excerpt: Local market data reported the retail tranche was oversubscribed 5,784.7 times, with cornerstone investors including Alibaba Investment, GIC and Temasek subscribing to more than 71% of the offering.

key_facts.fact: Lightelligence makes optical interconnect and optical-computing products that use light instead of electronic pathways to move data inside AI systems, reducing latency and power use in data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: Lightelligence makes optical interconnect and optical-computing products that use light instead of traditional electronic pathways to move data inside AI systems.

key_facts.fact: Revenue grew from RMB 38.2 million in 2023 to RMB 106 million in 2025, but the company suffered a net loss of RMB 1.34 billion in 2025 and held only 1.4% of China's optical interconnect market.
key_facts.excerpt: Lightelligence generated 106 million yuan in revenue in 2025, suffered a net loss of 1.34 billion yuan, and held only 1.4% of China's scale-up optical interconnect market

key_facts.fact: Frost & Sullivan forecasts the global AI computing and interconnect market will grow at a 27% compound annual rate through 2031.
key_facts.excerpt: Frost & Sullivan, as cited by SCMP, forecasts the global AI computing and interconnect market will grow at a 27% compound annual rate through 2031.

stories.headline: South Korea Surpasses UK as World's 8th-Largest Stock Market, Driven by Samsung and SK Hynix

key_facts.fact: South Korea's total stock market value has jumped more than 45% in 2026 to about $4.04 trillion, surpassing the UK's roughly $3.99 trillion to become the world's eighth-largest equity market.
key_facts.excerpt: South Korea's total market value has jumped more than 45% so far in 2026, while the UK's rose about 3% to roughly $3.99 trillion.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix make up more than 40% of the Kospi index's total value, concentrating the rally in AI-linked semiconductor stocks.
key_facts.excerpt: those two firms make up more than 40% of the Kospi index's total value, so the benchmark can look strong even if the rest of the economy is having a quieter year.

key_facts.fact: Taiwan also recently overtook the UK to become the world's seventh-largest equity market at around $4.48 trillion, driven largely by TSMC.
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan overtook the UK in April to become the world's seventh-largest equity market, with total value around $4.48 trillion – powered largely by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing

key_facts.fact: The ranking shift reflects how market size is increasingly a supply-chain scoreboard, set by who controls critical links in global tech supply chains.
key_facts.excerpt: market heft is being set by who controls critical links in global tech supply chains, not just by how many big companies a country has.

stories.headline: EU Unveils DMA Proposals to Force Google to Open Android to Rival AI Services

key_facts.fact: EU antitrust regulators unveiled new proposals under the Digital Markets Act aimed at opening Google's Android ecosystem to rivals' AI services on Monday April 27.
key_facts.excerpt: Alphabet's Google was given pointers by EU antitrust regulators on Monday on how to help online search rivals and artificial intelligence developers access

key_facts.fact: The measures target Google's AI integration with Android, aiming to let users choose alternative AI assistants and services on their devices.
key_facts.excerpt: Google was targeted by European Union watchdogs who unveiled a slate of proposals aimed at prising open its Android ecosystem to rivals' AI services.

key_facts.fact: Google said the EU measures are 'unwarranted intervention' in the Android ecosystem.
key_facts.excerpt: The EU on Monday laid out measures it wants Google to take to open up its operating system to rival AI services, in a move slammed by the US tech giant.

stories.headline: US Data Center Pipeline Hits 780 GW — Exceeding National Peak Load — as Rural Communities Push Back

key_facts.fact: There are 780 gigawatts of announced data center projects in the US, exceeding the country's current total peak load of 759 GW, according to Aurora Energy Research.
key_facts.excerpt: There are 780 gigawatts of announced data center projects in the U.S., which is more than the country's current total peak load of 759 GW.

key_facts.fact: EPC firm McCarthy Building Companies says construction timelines for data centers have tripled from 6 months to 18 months, and estimates only one in four queued projects is real.
key_facts.excerpt: A year ago it took six months to break ground on a data center project, he said, and now it's more like 18 months... You look at the queue and maybe one of four [projects] is real

key_facts.fact: Grid Strategies quadrupled its earlier prediction to 166 GW of peak demand growth over the next five years, with about 90 GW tied to data centers specifically.
key_facts.excerpt: Grid Strategies... quadrupled its earlier prediction to 166 GW over the next five years, with about 90 GW of that tied to data center development specifically

key_facts.fact: Pew data shows 67% of planned data centers are in rural areas, while 87% of existing ones are in urban areas, and many rural communities are 'viscerally opposed' to AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Many rural communities are viscerally opposed to AI infrastructure, putting them at odds with the White House

key_facts.fact: In Archbald, Pennsylvania (population ~7,000), residents are pushing back against six proposed data center campuses that would cover about 14% of the town's land.
key_facts.excerpt: Developers plan to build 6 sprawling data center campuses in Archbald, Pa, covering about 14% of the town's land

key_facts.fact: Aurora Energy Research modeled adding 10 GW of data center load in ERCOT without new transmission and found it would quintuple congestion costs and spike power prices by 34%.
key_facts.excerpt: quintupling congestion costs and spiking power prices by 34%
